jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (f/m/d) - Life Science and Diagnostics (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About this opportunity

In the position of a (Junior) Software Engineer (f/m/d) in Life Science and Diagnostics at QIAGEN, you will be making improvements in life possible – every working day. We are looking for you to help us shape our product development with skill and passion. You will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control software for laboratory devices as well as data analysis software to process test results helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample.

Your Tasks
* As a Software Engineer you will typically work in project teams of 5-10 people and gain experience in different roles throughout the life cycle of a software development project.
* You will start as a software developer or (automated) software tester in one of our scrum teams. Throught your professional career you will have the opportunity to grow into senior roles such as senior engineer, product owner, software architect or verification manager.  
* You will work across teams and across sites to generate the best possible solution for our products in a complex environment of Biology, Chemistry, Mechanics, Electronics and Software.
* You will be based at QIAGEN Hilden, our operational headquarter and will have the opportunity to visit our international development sites in Aarhus, Denmark or Wroclaw, Poland to strengthen and refine your software development capabilities.

Your Profile
* You have a master’s degree in computer science, with a minor in medicine, science or engineering
* You show a strong interest in software and product development and have already gained first professional experience.
* You love science and have a strong analytical mindset that strives to analyze, understand and solve problems.
* You are highly organized, work independently and easily adapt to changing work environment.
* You show excellent communication skills in both, English and German (C1 level)
* Ideally, you are familiar with working with AI-powered development tools or large language models to automate software development lifecycle processes. Experience with connecting AI agents with third-party systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus

Please provide a transcript of record and an employer's reference if applicable.

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Control Specification Engineer (f/m/d) for Gas Turbine Auxiliaries, you work on open-loop control and protection specifications throughout the entire lifecycle of auxiliary systems, from concept development to commissioning support. You collaborate with engineers, suppliers, instrumentation specialists, and commissioning teams to align technical requirements and ensure seamless system integration. Some days are dedicated to specification development and documentation, while others involve resolving operational challenges, supporting project teams, or addressing site issues. You work in an international environment with colleagues from diverse technical and cultural backgrounds.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for reference engineering and control specification development for gas turbine fuel systems
* Technical ownership of auxiliary systems, including control, protection, and functional performance aspects
* Coordination and clarification of interfaces with engineering teams, suppliers, commissioning personnel, and other stakeholders
* Creation and maintenance of automation specifications, parameter lists, interface documentation, and related technical documents
* Support for customer-specific engineering requirements and project adaptations
* Back-office support for site activities, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues

What You Bring

* Degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering, or a comparable technical field
* Professional experience in control and protection system design with knowledge of relevant engineering disciplines
* Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to solving technical challenges
* Ability to develop practical and innovative solutions while considering implementation risks
* Strong communication and coordination skills for interdisciplinary collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
* Highly proficient written and spoken English with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
PVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes the iconic brands CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, with more than 30.000 employees operating in over 40 countries. PVH stands for development and innovation like no other company with the ongoing digitalization and integration of all channels.

One of PVH's greatest strengths is our people and our shared desire to create an inclusive work environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard. Together, we are committed to a more diverse and fair fashion industry to drive sustainable change both at PVH and in our industry.

The head office for the DACH and EEC markets, covering 13 countries with more than 2.700 employees, is in Düsseldorf and is the main location of around 500 employees.

The purpose of the Specialist Regional Risk Management is to manage, coordinate and drive all profit protection related topics in region, including data analysis and reporting. The goal is to create maximum transparency with regards to in-store transactions and processes and ensuring a high level of compliance. In addition, the reduction of regional shrinkage, the identification of priority stores and the performance of (virtual) store audits are highly important tasks to achieve.

A day in the life of a Specialist Retail Risk Management Region West (m/f/x):

- You will be responsible for reviewing and improving store processes to minimize loss and ensure compliance with company policies
- You will analyze in-store transactions, stock discrepancies, and cash differences to identify risks and drive corrective actions
- You will support the creation and update of internal policies, procedures, and operational guidelines related to loss prevention and profit protection
- You will collaborate with Central Risk Management, Local Operations and other departments to implement regional risk and profit protection plans
- You will provide practical support and solutions to all stores on high incident levels or elevated risk
- You will ensure all security systems (e.g., CCTV, alarms, EAS) are functional and store staff are trained in their proper use
- You will assist in investigations into suspected internal dishonesty or policy breaches, in coordination with HR and Legal
- You will deliver training to store teams on loss prevention practices, risk awareness, and emergency procedures
- You will conduct regular audits to monitor compliance with loss prevention policies and follow up on any findings

What do we need from you? You have:                                                                     

- University degree in business, economics, textile or related fields - or comparable education with relevant work experience
- Previous experience in profit protection, ideally gained within a retail environment
- Ability to research and analyze multiple data streams to make informed decisions
- Knowledge of store processes and procedures
- Strong project and time management skills with excellent attention to detail
- Knowledge of local/ regional store processes, laws & regulations and cultural needs
- Very good analytical skills, as well as advanced knowledge in Microsoft Excel and SAP BW
- Independent, highly structured and precise way of working
- Professional and authentic appearance & communication, discreet workstyle
- Willingness to travel if necessary      
- Fluent in both written and spoken English and German                                                                                                                                           

What you can expect from us:

- PVH offers you a smart working model (hybrid) including a flex office solution, a "work from anywhere" concept, meeting-free Fridays and many other components
- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. The PVH Leadership Behaviors are the actions that unlock the potential of each of us. Whether you lead a team, a project or contribute your own expertise, everyone is a leader at PVH
- We promote a culture of development and offer training and learning opportunities through our own PVH University
- Multiple employee benefits such as employee discounts, mobility offers, internal sports classes and other initiatives

Our employees come together from all areas of life and all corners of the world. Inclusion and diversity are a key pillar of our corporate culture. We know that diversity makes us stronger. Regardless of your origin, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender you are welcome here.
